<DOCSTRING>
Initialize the game with the given parameters.

Args:
    board_size (int): The size of the game board, must be a positive integer.
    player_1_name (str): Name of the first player, must be a non-empty string.
    player_2_name (str): Name of the second player, must be a non-empty string.

Description:
This constructor initializes a new game with the specified board size and two players. It sets up the game state by creating Player objects for each player and initializing the current player. The game board is also created and assigned to each player. This object is used to manage the game flow, including turns and game state updates.
</DOCSTRING>
